component.name: B9X Cooler
component.summary: Control the Flydigi B9X phone cooler

description.p: Unofficial controller for the Flydigi B9X phone cooler over Bluetooth LE, without the official app. Not affiliated with Flydigi.

ul.li: Live cold plate temperature with a graph, fan speed and cooling output
Cooling mode, presets and the custom cooling curve
Quick switch, OC Experience and scheduled shutdown

description.p: Only frames the official app was seen sending are ever written to the cooler.
First release of the Rust CLI and the GTK app.
